entries.dialogueText: Monica approached me and kissed me on the cheek. A tantalizing smell wafted from the kitchen behind her.

entries.dialogueText: Zabla was one of my hometown's specialties -- a chickpea stew topped with beef braised in tomatoes and Bergian spices, traditionally served in a clay pot.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was absolutely my favorite dish..."
entries.dialogueText: It was absolutely my favorite dish -- especially paired with Kebij, a potent unfiltered wine from my region.

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.dialogueText: "What, you and Petr didn't booze it up enough back at the palace?"

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.dialogueText: “I'm hungry!”

entries.dialogueText: “We'll eat in just a minute. Will you help me set the table?”

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.dialogueText: “Anton, can you tell Franc to come down for dinner? He's been sulking in his room all day.”

entries.dialogueText: Monica started taking out the plates while I headed upstairs to fetch my son.

entries.dialogueText: Loud rock 'n' roll music echoed down the hallway from his room. I caught a faint hint of cigarette smoke.

entries.dialogueText: As we started eating, the room went quiet. Monica's cooking was as delicious as ever, but I had the feeling that wasn't the reason nobody spoke.

entries.dialogueText: Monica was the first to break the silence.

entries.dialogueText: Franc suddenly slammed his hands on the table, rattling the plates. Monica, Deana and I stared at him.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“So, this is how it's going to be?..."
entries.dialogueText: “So, this is how it's going to be? We're just going to sit here like nothing happened?"

entries.menuText: “And what would you have us do?”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “And yet, we are all still alive.”
entries.menuText: “And yet, we are all still alive.”

entries.menuText: “You will not raise your voice to me, young man.”

entries.dialogueText: “I don't know. Talk about it. Maybe.”

entries.dialogueText: “For now. But how long until this happens again?”

entries.speaker: Franc

entries.speaker: Franc

entries.dialogueText: "You don't care! You don't care what happens to me or Deana or anyone else--"

entries.speaker: Franc

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stormed out of the dining room...."
entries.dialogueText: He stormed out of the dining room. Deana started crying. Monica soothed her for a bit, then plopped her in front of the living room TV and returned to the table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I opened the door and there she was..."
entries.dialogueText: I opened the door and there she was, standing in front of me with expectant eyes.

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.dialogueText: “Say, did you know that they refurbished the grocery store?”

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.dialogueText: “I don't know if you remember the owner -- he's been there every day for the past 30 years.”

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.dialogueText: “Can you imagine doing the same job for so long? What if you were president for 20 years, for example?”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “Honestly, would that really be so bad?"
entries.menuText: “Honestly, would that really be so bad?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't want this country to suffe..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't want this country to suffer under another Soll.”
entries.menuText: “I don't want this country to suffer under another Soll.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“20 years of this? I'd be dead!""
entries.dialogueText: “20 years of this? I'd be dead!"
entries.menuText: “20 years of this? I'd be dead!"

entries.speaker: Monica
